Volkswagen Approves Major Restructuring, Slashing Up To 100,000 Jobs

Volkswagen has approved a significant restructuring plan, "Future Plan 2030," which includes cutting up to 100,000 jobs globally by the end of the decade. The plan involves the biggest overhaul in the company's history and will impact its German plants. The job cuts are part of an effort to streamline operations and ensure the company's survival. The restructuring is expected to have a broad impact on the global auto industry. Some reports indicate that brands like Lamborghini and Porsche could also be affected.
